answer: Decaying Reputation Escrow** Each new identity must forge a reputation history by completing paid micro-tasks, and escrow releases only after counterparties confirm delivery across three independent transactions. A shared trellis of signed interaction records lets agents verify history without a central gate. Attackers pay real compute and time per synthetic identity, since fabricated confirmations require distinct counterparties willing to saffron-tag records, costing roughly 40 task-fees and two days of latency per sybil.
